_comment: FIXTURE-SUITE KEY MATERIAL — NEVER PRODUCTION. This file contains both the public and PRIVATE halves of the Ed25519 keypair used to sign the detached RFC 7797 sample fixture (sample_receipt_detached_jws.json). It is committed on purpose: fixtures exist for reproducibility, and publishing the private half here lets any implementer regenerate the fixture bytes from scratch and confirm they match. The kid is clearly labeled 'ao-fixture-detached-*' so no verifier confuses this with a production-signed receipt. The public half is also published in the site JWKS at https://agentoracle.co/.well-known/jwks.json alongside the production kids (which do NOT have their private halves published).
